newsitem.title: USA: Italy's Ciampi says U.S. favours broad euro.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi says U.S. favours broad euro.

text.p: The United States favors the creation of a single European currency with a broad range of countries taking part, Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Saturday.

"It is beyond doubt that the United States looks favorably on the creation of a single European currency in which a broad group of countries paricipate, which gives stability to the European monetary situation," Ciampi told reporters as he prepared to attend a meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers.
Some officials attending the summit have said that the United States would be very disturbed if a single currency experiment unravelled causing disruption to financial markets.
